## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:services` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T00:01Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** the out-of-office notification bodies name people by raw `sys_user` id. It is the person half of #23978 (p2), whose PR #24064 fixes the record half.

Claim: PM loop round 2 of this seat's second term · 2026-10-17T03:35Z
Session: `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs `mode:subagent` in this session's container and shares its session ID, so its identity is the branch)
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user, as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-24065-ooo-notification-names`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24065`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface (at `origin/main` `27d7c2aa1d` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, `openNodeRequest`'s OOO fan-out: the two notification bodies (`:3624`, `:3636`) name the person through the plugin's one person-label chain (`resolveUserNames`, `:6664`). The audit `comment` at `:3613` changes only if the dev's reading of its readers says so.
- the plugin's tests: one pin at the real send path (the `ooo` case in `approval-notification-body.integration.test.ts` or a sibling).
- one `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`.
Exclusions:
- ⛔ No second name resolver. ⛔ Do not change `resolveUserNames`' fallback or its `sys_user` field-level-security coupling (PR #23984).
- ⛔ Not the record half (#23978, landed), nor any other notification body.
Container & model: `M (narrow): two strings in one method, one pin`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`TIER_DEFAULT`; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no. A notification body's wording changes. No export, type or accept set moves.
Responsibility: `plugin-approvals (this lane): the OOO bodies interpolate raw sys_user ids | the person-label chain from PR #23984 already covers display names | every substitute and skipped approver who receives an OOO notification`
Thread-read: 6227008327
Serial constraints cleared: this seat has nothing else in flight (#23985's PR #24139 is accepted and touches only `examples/app-showcase`). No open PR touches `approval-service.ts` (open-PR read now).
Premise to falsify first: on `origin/main`, both bodies interpolate `sub.from` / `sub.to` as raw ids, and the real send path stores that text.
